name: Hatsuse Miki
source:
An AV actress who shows off a bold figure while exuding a mysterious air.

She is a manager of an AV company and an active AV actress.
Although she gives off a cool and calm impression, she has also appeared in many AV works with hard content.
Each of her works has been well-received, and she has many passionate fans.
Recently, she has reduced the number of appearances, and has started to look after new AV actresses as an on-site manager.

Because she doesn't say much and her facial expressions are not very changeable, she is often intimidated by people who meet her for the first time, but she is caring and is loved by many newcomers.
Sheis a talented actress and manager, and is highly valued by the company.

She tends to give off a mysterious impression because she only speaks the bare minimum.
She is an orphan, and her private life is relatively shrouded in mystery.
